answer_1.quote: We aim to design a query reformulation model to transform the current query q i together with the conversational historical context H k into a de-contextualized rewritten query for conversational search. A first desired behavior of query reformulation is to produce a similar rewritten query as a human expert.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the retrieval results, we use four standard evaluation metrics: MRR, NDCG@3, Recall@10 and Recall@100, as previous studies.
